observed_value: cost_currency values U_AUD, U_EUR, U_CHF, and U_GBP on 15 rows
anchor_value: Cost column denominated in USD per schedule dollar totals

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Ancora Bidco PTY LTD (6) | Unitranche First Lien Term Loan | ... | Principal Amount ... AUD 3,402 | Cost 3,362 | Fair Value 3,409

findings.detail: The principal/par column carries foreign currency symbols, but the cost and fair value columns are USD-denominated by their dollar subtotal rows; cost_currency should not inherit the principal currency.

rationale: FX03 is a real data error. In the raw schedule, foreign currency appears in the Principal Amount, Par Value or Shares column, such as AUD 3,402 for Ancora, EUR-denominated principal rows in Netherlands/France/Cayman/Ireland/Germany/Finland, CHF principal for Solvias, and GBP principal for UK names. The Cost and Fair Value columns are separate valuation columns and their country subtotals are explicitly shown with dollar signs, e.g. Total Debt Investments Australia $3,349 cost and $3,410 fair value, Netherlands $7,731 and $8,575, Switzerland $9,979 and $11,789, and United Kingdom $6,565 and $7,142. The stored non-USD cost_currency values therefore reflect misattribution of the principal currency to the USD cost field.
